lines.title: When your AI tools read your notes, where does that text go? The router can tell you, request by request.
lines.map: Point it at your notes: an Obsidian vault here, or Claude Code's own memory. It maps every note and every link, like Obsidian's graph view.
lines.local: Ask Claude Code about the billing migration, and it reads that note. A local model answers, so the note stays on this machine. The live page shows exactly that.
lines.cloud: Now ask Opus to review the plan, and the note goes along with the conversation. The map marks it: this note has been sent to the cloud.
lines.secret: Some things should never go. With secret detection on, once a conversation holds a key or a token, it stays local, even if you ask for Opus.
lines.audit: And every request is on the record. The activity log shows which notes each request carried, and which ones a credential kept local.
lines.end: Semantic Router dot net. Know what leaves your machine. It's open source, and MIT licensed.
